build_mlp_feedforward_network: build a feedforward neural network with configurable sizes, bias, batchnorm, and grouped linear layers
build_convolutional_neural_network: build a 2D convolutional neural network with configurable channels, kernel sizes, residual connections, and grouped convolutions
